gpg_conf_path.description: Optional absolute path to gpg.conf; if empty, uses default ~/.gnupg/gpg.conf

sign_by_default.description: Sign all outgoing messages by default (user prompt still required unless auto_sign=true)

encrypt_by_default.description: Encrypt all outgoing messages by default (recipient key required and user prompt still required unless auto_encrypt=true)

auto_sign.description: Automatically sign messages without prompting the user

auto_encrypt.description: Automatically encrypt messages without prompting the user

strict_encryption.description: Refuse to send if encryption is requested but no valid key found for recipient

include_key.description: Include public key in signed or encrypted messages (useful for interoperability)

use_ascii_armored.description: Use ASCII armored format for PGP/Inline messages (required for text-only channels)

use_gpgme.description: Use GPGME backend (required by Claws Mail pgpinline plugin)
